state.objective: Determine why browser blocks POST requests from app.domain.com to api.domain.com.

submitted_answer.answer: The browser blocks the credentialed cross-origin POST because CORS combines a wildcard origin with allow_credentials=true, which is invalid. Configure an explicit allowed origin such as https://app.domain.com and enable credentials only for that origin.
